_doc: M2.5 micro-Blokus run config. Every scalar here is pinned doc-first in metadocs/blokus-duo-az-design-v0_5.md - the game instance in section 5.3, the gate protocol in section 12 (M2.5). tests/test_micro_config_file.py golden-checks this file against those pins; change the doc first, never this file alone.
name: blokus_micro

self_play._doc: The shared core.selfplay.SelfPlayConfig sub-shape. M3's RunConfig composes this same object; the sim count stays a config field (M3's fixed-128 assertion lives in its actor layer, not here).

training._doc: publish_interval/checkpoint_count are the M3 §6.2 pin (interval 200, K = 30; total_steps = 6000 for core.learner.LearnerDriver's own async stop condition, independent of the M2.5 fixed-budget learner_steps above). replay_warmup_positions is an implementation-level knob (not design-doc-pinned): the minimum positions_stored before the [2, 4] replay-ratio band is enforced.

evaluation._doc: Evaluation seed is deliberately independent of the run seed: the fixed paired set must not be coupled to training.

loss_predicates._doc: Separate policy and value predicates, each a tail mean over a pinned step window compared against the same run's head window. Read from the persisted run record, never recomputed ad hoc.

throughput._doc: Dedicated spike run; the official verdict requires the RTX 4060 Ti with CUDA + AMP. GO iff projected full-game games/hour at M3's fixed 128 sims and 35 plies/game reaches the floor.
